message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a white background at the top and a digital painting below. The large red word "TEMPO" is centered near the top. Above it, black text reads "Eddy Hiariej Membelah KPK H.80" and "Di Balik Penolakan Pengungsi Rohingya H.36". Below "TEMPO" is the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". To the right, smaller text includes "25-31 DESEMBER 2023", "RP 50.000", and a barcode with a QR code.

The main headline reads "BEKING MOBIL LISTRIK WULING" in bold black letters. A paragraph below details allegations involving "Moeldoko", the "Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral", and "Wuling".

The central figure is a man with tan skin, dark hair, and a slight smile, wearing a white short-sleeved shirt. On his left wrist is a large silver and black watch. He holds a black electric vehicle charging nozzle in his right hand. To his right, a light-colored car is parked, showing its rear charging port. Behind him stands a white charging station. The man’s right hand is open toward the car. The lighting is bright, casting shadows on the man's face and shirt.
